evidence.name: Screen field: Spacing around the progress bar
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Spacing around the progress bar" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Spacing around the progress bar
sections.description: Sets the spacing on each side of the progress indicator alone, separate from the header's overall padding. Use it to fine-tune the gap around the bar, for example to nudge it down from the buttons, without moving the buttons themselves. Most funnels keep the default; adjust only when the bar sits too tight or too loose against the header.
